subject: NovaPay pilot — commercial & security onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaPay pilot — commercial & security onboarding checklist

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same page: 

Call recap
- Pilot scope: 2 internal teams, production-like traffic window (3 days), success metric = 95th pct latency under 400ms + accuracy baseline vs current rule engine
- Champion: you (product) — thanks for offering to surface this to Marco (security) and procurement
- Economic buyer: you indicated Finance/CFO (Lucia) will sign off once SLA and cost cadence are clear

Open items (asks from NovaPay)
1) Security: Marco requested a short data flow + SOC2 evidence and encryption/KMS notes
2) Procurement: standard PO/terms timeline + any vendor on-boarding docs
3) Commercial: high-level pricing sheet for a 3-day pilot and slot reservation policy

Next steps (Redwood actions)
- I attached a proposed mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan-novapay.xlsx) and a pilot MOP (nova-pay-pilot-mop-v1.pdf). Please review and flag gaps by EOD Monday.
- Ben will lead the security checklist and consolidate SOC2 docs for Marco.
- Mina will build a 1-slide ROI talk track for your sponsor (CFO) and a short one-pager you can forward internally.
- Schedule: suggest a 30-min legal/procurement sync w/ Marco + procurement group next Wednesday (11/11) — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-novapay.xlsx (xlsx), nova-pay-pilot-mop-v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks again — brief bullets so you can paste into an internal thread. Happy to adapt.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novapay.com>

Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: NovaPay pilot — commercial & security onboarding checklist

Connor — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from my side and a procurement timeline attached:

Questions: 
- For the SOC2 evidence, can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a report + a short summary specifically calling out network encryption and key management (we use an internal KMS and will need to route questions to security)?
- The pilot MOP references an "SLA cadence" — can you summarize what uptime/latency commitment you’re willing to put in for a short pilot vs a paid Dedicated contract?
- Procurement: our standard process requires a vendor risk questionnaire. I’ve attached procurement_timeline_novapay.pdf and cc'd procurement.

Procurement note (from procurement@novapay.com):
> We typically need 2–3 weeks for vendor onboarding (risk review + PO). For pilots we can compress to 7 business days if security sign-off is received prior.

I’ll coordinate with Marco on the specific security questions; he’s out Monday but can meet Tue/Wed. Tentatively OK for the 11/11 slot if Connor can do morning PT.

—Elena
Product Manager, NovaPay
elena.rossi@novapay.com

Connor / Mina — quick internal note before we reply to Marco/procurement:

Security deliverables I’ll assemble:
- SOC2 Type II summary + control mapping (we’ll include a 1-page summary called "SOC2-quickview.pdf")
- Data flow diagram showing what data touches Redwood, where it is encrypted at rest/in-transit, and KMS approach (customer-managed KMS options documented)
- List of logging/audit capabilities (token-level audit, request tracing, retention windows) and an export with retention SLA

Commercial notes for Mina to prepare for Elena’s sponsor: 
- 3-day pilot pricing: we’ll propose a fixed pilot fee + optional overage — I’ll send suggested ranges. Keep the ROI slide focused on latency reduction -> checkout throughput improvement + developer time savings for one use-case.

Procurement cadence: happy path = security sign-off (Marco) + PO within 7 business days. If Marco needs deeper evidence we should offer a short security call with our Infosec lead; offer them a redacted SOC2 read-only session if needed.

Action items:
- Ben: SOC2-quickview.pdf & data flow (ETA Mon EOD PT)
- Mina: ROI slide + sponsor one-pager (ETA Mon 2pm PT)
- Connor: draft legal/procurement invite and include DocuSign links for pilot terms if approved

I’ll hold off replying to procurement until we have the SOC2 summary.

Ben Carter
Security & Compliance Liaison | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
